title: Page 2
content_zh:
想到出嫁前爹爹苍老担忧的神情，她紧咬牙根，眼中有着坚定。

她不能不孝，让老父承担她的过错。

稳住心头的紧张，她沉静的又说：「我的处子之身正是被你所夺，就算无人知晓，但紫嫣知道，要是她知道你在她离开的次日就将我休离，理由竟是新婚夜我没有落红，你说，紫嫣会怎么看待你？」

光想着紫嫣会对自己露出失望的神色，他就无法忍受，更何况是让她知道他是刻意迎绦岚秋入门，再让她难堪？

俊眸盛载满满的怒火，下颚紧绷，他不得不说绦岚秋果真心机深沉，懂得以紫嫣来要胁他，而偏偏他最见不得的就是紫嫣难过。

「说！你有什么条件！」他咬牙切齿的迸出这句话。

知道他妥协，绦岚秋顿时松了口气，却也感到心酸。

紫嫣呀紫嫣，你错了，他永远不会属于我，因为他的心满满全是你的身影，只要一提起你，他什么都能容忍，包括她这「不知羞耻」的女人……

眨去眼中的热浪，她不愿再想，抬起螓首正视他，轻声说：「我的条件很简单，第一，就算你休了我，我依然要住在封家。第二，不能让任何人知道这件事。」

「你打算赖在我这一辈子？」他怒瞪着她。

这女人到底知不知道什么叫下堂妻？一个被休离的女人竟然敢开出这样荒谬的条件

「你放心，只要一年。」深吸一口气，她哑声又说：「我要你答应我一年内不能让任何人知道我被休离一事、不能传出让绦家丢脸的流言，并在我家人来访时，和我扮演一对恩爱的夫妻，不让人看出破绽，只要你答应，一年后，我会告诉紫嫣是我自己要求和离，并搬离这里。」

一年的时间，应该够她自立生活，应该够让她……忘了他。

「我凭什么相信你？」这女人太狡诈，他不得不防。

「口说无凭，那就立字为约。」她沙哑的说，心因为他的不信任及防备而阵阵抽痛着。

封竞天思索着她开出的条件，许久之后才点头答应。「好，就立字为约，到时要是你敢违约，我用轰的也会把你轰出封府！」说完，他一刻也不想停留，转身拂袖而去。

第1章(2)

看着他绝情的背影逐渐离去，绦岚秋挺直的腰杆这才松下，滴悬在眼眶里的泪水再也忍不住落下，滴落在红潋潋的喜帕上，散出一朵黑色的泪花。

竹儿疼惜的看着哭成泪人儿的主子，她每落一滴泪，她也跟着难过一分。

「小姐，你别再哭了……」竹儿劝道。

小姐……不，原本她该改口唤她一声夫人，谁知……

她本来和小姐欢欢喜喜的等着新郎官，谁知原本她要唤声姑爷的男人进了喜房，却没有半点喜色，反而脸色阴霾的把她及一干伺候他们用餐、说吉祥话的丫鬟、喜娘给赶出房，他那不寻常的反应让她感到不安，于是躲在房外偷听，这才知道小姐竟受了这么大的委屈。

一想到那可恶的男人，竹儿忍不住咬牙切齿，「真是太过分了！既然不喜欢我们家小姐，当初何必允婚？都已经拜了堂、成了亲，居然在新婚之夜就说要休妻那个封竞天根本就是故意的！他故意要让小姐你难堪，小姐你又何必为了那种人伤心？」

坐在只有一个人的喜床上，绦岚秋只是来回抚着她当初怀着待嫁喜悦的心情、一针一线缝绣的鸳鸯枕，默默流着泪。

她那模样看在打小就跟在她身旁的竹儿眼里更是难过，她蓦地站起身，就要往外冲，「不行！我要去找封竞天说清楚，这根本就不是小姐的错，明明就是他……」

「竹儿，」绦岚秋忙喊住自己的贴身丫鬟，对她摇头，「别去。」

「为何不去？」竹儿瞪大双眼，气愤难平，「要是不向他解释清楚，他还真以为受委屈的人是他，硬是将那些莫须有的罪名强加在小姐身上！」

她气不过，小姐就是太过好脾气，才会被那可恶的男人给欺上头，只是她不懂，为何小姐不解释？

绦岚秋敛下泪眸，原本温婉清柔的嗓音因为哭泣而变得嘶哑，「他既已认定，我又何必多作解释，不过是自取其辱罢了。」

她爱封竞天，所以了解他，知道像他这样的人中之龙，不会容许他人的欺骗，他既已认定一切都是她的计谋，又怎会相信她的话？他对她不信任，就算她说破嘴，也不过是让他更看轻、更鄙视自己而已。

「难道小姐就要白白蒙受这不白之冤？」竹儿气得直跺脚，「事实明明就不是如此，他却把小姐说得如此不堪，他要小姐以后如何见人？」

事实……什么是事实？

绦岚秋闭上双眼，疲累的揉着泛酸的双眼，「竹儿，别说了，这件事不要再提起，就算他知道所谓的事实又如何？他依然不是甘愿娶我。」

是呵！知道如何、不知又如何？他爱的人仍不会是她，而是她活泼甜美的妹妹，既然如此，她何必用责任强逼他？强摘的瓜不甜，这道理她懂，所以一直以来她都是默默看着他、恋着他，从未奢望能成为他的妻，然而……

她本以为他肯娶她是对紫嫣死了心、本以为他是因为被自己对他的感情所感动，却没想到这一切只是他的报复……报复她的痴心妄想。

溢满眼眶的泪水又滑落，仿佛在耻笑她的天真、她的愚蠢。

「但是……」

「我说了，别再提。」她不容置喙的打断竹儿的话。

绦岚秋看似脾性温顺却十分执拗，她不愿之事，不论是谁都无法强逼，深知这点的竹儿就算再气闷心疼，也只能乖乖闭上嘴。

「我累了，你先下去吧！」她闭上双眼，趴在绣着交颈鸳鸯的枕上。

「那竹儿就先出去了，小姐要是有什么吩咐，竹儿就在门外。」竹儿轻叹一声，退出这独留新娘一人的新房。

直到听见阖门声，绦岚秋才缓缓张开哭红的双眼，纤指一下下的抚着身旁空荡荡的喜床，恍惚间，她想起那一夜——

大红灯笼高高挂，今日是绦家二小姐绦紫嫣出阁之日。

绦家在京城是有名的商贾世家，绦家家主绦威就只有绦岚秋及绦紫嫣这两个宝贝千金，照理论辈分，该是年满十八的大女儿先出阁，但绦老爷疼女儿，婚事皆由女儿们自个儿作主，即便向绦岚秋提亲的对象多到快将绦家的门槛给踏平，可绦岚秋一句不喜欢、不中意，绦老爷也只能一一回绝，也因此，年龄小一岁的二女儿都要出阁了，大女儿依然待字闺中。

喜宴席开上百桌，从绦家大院一路绵延至大街上。

今日来喝喜酒的宾客们，半数以上都是京城里大小商家的老板，这些满脑子生意经的店老板难得在不谈生意的情况下碰面，还没等开席就已经举杯喝了起来。

且绦老爷交游广阔，也结交了不少江湖人士，加上新郎官远从北方来的宾客好友个个豪爽直率，两方一碰面，不论熟不熟识，早已喝成一片，场面热闹非凡。

宾客陆续入席，没多久，就听见司仪大喊，「吉时已到，新郎、新娘入场——」

长长的尾音回荡四周，原本举杯豪饮的众人纷纷搁下酒杯，引领而望，等待着新人入场。

不一会儿，就见身材高大剽悍的新郎牵着比他娇小许多的新娘子进场，他刚毅严谨的酷颜因大喜之日露出淡淡的喜悦，鹰一般锐利的双眸中满是期待。
content_en:
Thinking of her father's old and worried look before getting married, she gritted her teeth with determination in her eyes.

She couldn't be unfilial and let her father bear her fault.

Calming down the tension in her heart, she said calmly: "You took my virginity away from me. Even if no one knows it, Zi Yan knows that if she knew that you divorced me the day after she left, the reason was that I didn't fall asleep on the wedding night. What do you think Zi Yan would think of you?"

He couldn't bear just the thought that Zi Yan would look disappointed at him, let alone let her know that he was deliberately welcoming Gui Lanqiu into the family and embarrass her again?

His handsome eyes were full of anger and his jaw was tense. He had to say that Gui Lan Qiu Guo was really scheming and knew how to use Zi Yan to threaten him, but what he couldn't bear to see the most was Zi Yan's sadness.

"Say! What are your conditions!" He said these words through gritted teeth.

Knowing that he compromised, Guan Lanqiu was relieved, but also felt sad.

Zi Yan, Zi Yan, you are wrong, he will never belong to me, because his heart is full of your presence. As long as you are mentioned, he can tolerate anything, including a "shameless" woman like her...

Blinking away the heat wave in her eyes, she didn't want to think about it anymore. She raised her head and looked at him and said softly: "My conditions are very simple. First, even if you divorce me, I will still live in the Feng family. Second, no one can know about this."

"Are you going to stay with me for the rest of your life?" He glared at her angrily.

Does this woman know what a cousin wife is?How dare a divorced woman offer such ridiculous conditions?

"Don't worry, it only takes one year." She took a deep breath and said hoarsely: "I want you to promise me that within one year, you will not let anyone know about my divorce, and you will not spread any rumors that will embarrass the Sui family. When my family comes to visit, you and I will act like a loving couple, so that no one will notice our flaws. As long as you agree, after one year, I will tell Zi Yan that it was me who requested the divorce, and move out of here."

One year should be enough time for her to live independently, enough time for her to... forget about him.

"Why should I trust you?" This woman was too cunning, and he had to guard against her.

"There is nothing to prove, so let's make a promise with words." She said hoarsely, her heart throbbing because of his distrust and defensiveness.

Feng Jingtian thought about the conditions she offered, and finally nodded in agreement after a long time."Okay, let's make this a promise. If you dare to break the contract, I will blast you out of the Feng Mansion!" After saying that, he didn't want to stay for a moment, turned around and walked away.

Chapter 1(2)

Seeing his heartless back gradually leaving, Guan Lanqiu's straight waist relaxed, and the tears hanging in her eyes could no longer hold back, falling onto the red and red wedding handkerchief, spreading out a black tear.

Zhu'er looked at her master who was crying with pity. Every time she shed a tear, she felt a little sadder.

"Miss, please stop crying..." Zhu'er advised.

Miss... No, she should have changed her name to "Madam", but who knows...

She and the young lady were happily waiting for the groom. Unexpectedly, the man she wanted to call uncle entered the wedding room, but he did not look happy at all. Instead, he drove her and the maidservants and Xi Niang out of the room with gloomy expressions. His unusual reaction made her feel uneasy, so she hid outside the room and eavesdropped. Only then did she realize that the young lady had suffered such great grievances.

Thinking of that hateful man, Zhu'er couldn't help but gnashed her teeth, "It's too much! If you don't like our lady, why did you agree to the marriage in the first place? We have already been married and married, and Feng Jingtian actually said that he wanted to divorce his wife on the wedding night. It was all intentional! He deliberately wanted to embarrass you, miss. Why should you feel sad for such a person?"

Sitting on the wedding bed with only one person, Guan Lanqiu just stroked the mandarin duck pillow that she had embroidered stitch by stitch with the joy of getting married, shedding tears silently.

She looked even sadder in the eyes of Zhu'er, who had been with her since she was a child. She stood up suddenly and was about to rush out, "No! I have to go to Feng Jingtian to make it clear that this is not Miss's fault at all, it is obviously him..."

"Zhu'er," Guan Lanqiu hurriedly called to her personal maid and shook her head, "Don't go."

"Why don't you go?" Zhu'er's eyes widened and she was furious. "If I don't explain it clearly to him, he really thinks that he is the one who is wronged and forces those unfounded charges on the young lady!"

She was so angry that the lady was bullied by that hateful man because she was too good-tempered. But she didn't understand. Why didn't the lady explain?

Guan Lanqiu held back her tears, and her originally gentle and gentle voice became hoarse due to crying, "Since he has already decided, why should I explain more, it is just humiliating myself."

She loves Feng Jingtian, so she knows him well, and knows that a dragon among men like him will not allow others to deceive him. How can he believe her words since he has determined that everything is her plan?He didn't trust her, and even if she told the truth, it would only make him look down on and despise herself even more.

"Is it true that Miss is going to suffer this unjust injustice in vain?" Zhu'er stomped her feet angrily, "That's clearly not the case, yet he talks about Miss in such a bad light. How does he want Miss to see anyone in the future?"

Facts...what are facts?

Qi Lanqiu closed her eyes and rubbed her sore eyes tiredly, "Zhu'er, stop talking. Don't mention this matter again. So what if he knows the so-called facts? He is still not willing to marry me."

Yes!What if you know, and what if you don’t know?The person he loves will still not be her, but her lively and sweet sister. In that case, why should she force him with responsibility?She knew that melons picked by force were not sweet, so she had been watching him silently and falling in love with him. She never expected to become his wife, but...

She thought that he was willing to marry her because he had given up on Zi Yan, and that he was moved by her feelings for him, but she didn't expect that all this was just his revenge... his wishful thinking to take revenge on her.

The tears that filled her eyes fell again, as if they were mocking her innocence and stupidity.

"But..."

"I said, don't mention it again." She interrupted Zhu'er without any hesitation.

Qi Lanqiu seems to have a gentle temper but is very stubborn. No one can force her to do something she doesn't want to do. Zhu'er, who knows this well, can only keep her mouth shut no matter how upset and distressed she is.

"I'm tired, you go down first!" She closed her eyes and lay on the pillow embroidered with cross-necked mandarin ducks.

"Then Zhu'er will go out first. If the lady has any instructions, Zhu'er will be outside the door." Zhu'er sighed softly and exited the bridal chamber where the bride was left alone.

It wasn't until she heard the door closing that Guan Lanqiu slowly opened her eyes, which were red from crying, and caressed the empty wedding bed beside her with her delicate fingers. In a daze, she remembered that night——

The red lanterns are hung high, today is the day when Sui Ziyan, the second daughter of the Sui family, leaves the palace.

The Sui family is a well-known merchant family in the capital. The head of the Sui family, Sui Wei, only has two precious daughters, Sui Lanqiu and Sui Ziyan. According to the theory of seniority, the eldest daughter who has reached eighteen years of age should be the first to leave the court. However, Mr. Sui loves his daughters, and all marriages are decided by the daughters themselves., even though there were so many people proposing marriage to Sui Lanqiu that the threshold of the Sui family was almost leveled, but if Sui Lanqiu didn't like or displease him, Master Sui could only reject them one by one. Therefore, the second daughter, who is one year younger, has to leave the court, and the eldest daughter is still waiting to be married.

There were hundreds of wedding banquet tables, stretching from the Sui Family Courtyard to the street.

Today, more than half of the guests who came to have a wedding banquet are the bosses of large and small businesses in the capital. It is rare for these business owners to meet without discussing business, and they have already started drinking before the banquet begins.

Mr. Qie Sui has a wide network of friends and has made many friends in the world. In addition, the groom's guests and friends from the north are all forthright and outspoken. As soon as the two parties meet, whether they are familiar with each other or not, they have already drank together, and the scene is very lively.

The guests were seated one after another, and not long after, they heard the master of ceremonies shout, "The auspicious time has come, the bridegroom and the bride are entering——"

The long tail sound echoed around, and everyone who had been toasting and drinking put down their glasses and looked around, waiting for the newcomers to enter.

After a while, a tall and powerful groom was seen entering the venue holding the bride, who was much smaller than him. His resolute and serious face revealed a hint of joy for the big day, and his sharp eyes like an eagle were full of anticipation.
